xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex70032024-10-17-14-15" status="unreviewed">gnyis pa rgyu thun mong ma yin pa lam shes pa nyid ni 'bras bu rnam mkhyen rtogs te thob pa ni rgyu lam shes pa med na med pas 'chad mod kyi rgyu sems bskyed la sogs bshad zin to || zhe na|  bden mod kyi sngar gyi 'khor ma dad pa spang ba'i phyir lam shes su ming btags nas 'chad <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4307">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4307">gzas pa</rs></note> zer ro| 'on kyang sngar rgyu 'bras ma lus pa mkhyen pa rnam mkhyen yin no || zhes shes pa'i don du gsungs nas 'dir rgyu dngos 'chad ces mtshams sbyar te bshad pa la gnyis| lam shes pa'i yan lag dang | yan lag can gyi lam shes pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
